profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a public company headquartered in Tel Aviv that trades under the ticker WIX and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001576789. Its website presents it as a website building platform. The company describes its builder as free and easy to use, offering 2,000+ templates, a custom domain, and built-in AI tools. It says users can customize templates manually or with AI, and that businesses can sell products, services, and memberships from a single dashboard without plugins.

On the AI side, the site points to built-in AI tools within the builder and to specialized AI agents that the company says help keep a business growing. No AI products are separately tracked in the company's record, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are listed for it.
